newsitem.title: NORWAY: Phillips delays Ekofisk restart plan to Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Phillips delays Ekofisk restart plan to Tuesday.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum said on Monday it planned to delay the restart of oil production at the North Sea Ekofisk field to 0100 GMT on Tuesday after an earlier projection of a restart today.
The 350,000 barrel per day development was shut in at 0400 GMT last Tuesday after an oil pipeline sprang a gas leak. A complete section of the pipeline had to be replaced.

"We will begin start up proceedures at 2 a.m. on Tuesday and we should be back to normal production very quickly," Phillips' spokesman Sander Bull-Gjertsen said. "It will be almost one week to the hour of shutdown."
Output from third party fields -- British Petroleum's Gyda and Ula and Amoco's Valhall and Hod -- and the Statpipe gas line was uninterupted by the unscheduled shutdown.
